name: multi-company-portal
description: Multi-company login portal that hosts the FinTrack financial app per tenant, with master/staff accounts.
whatsNew: Bank accounts can now have an OTP link saved. When one's set, a small "OTP link" button appears right on that bank's card, so you can jump straight to it while processing a transaction instead of hunting for it elsewhere.

Opening a bank account's transaction history (by clicking its card on the Bank Accounts page) now also shows the PayID at the top, alongside the BSB and account number — it was missing from there before.
The sign-in screen has a small new touch: the login card now gently fades and lifts into place when the page loads. It's purely a bit of visual polish, and signing in works exactly as before.
